style.backgroundSystem: alternating low-key studio cyclorama on #14161C / #101319 and pale technical surfaces on #F7F7F5 hairline grid, #F2F0ED marble and #EDEDEB matte plate; one continuous two-mode system across the set
style.direction: premium dark-tech helmet commerce with alternating low-key studio and pale technical grid screens
style.iconSystem: thin-line single-weight geometric icons, one stroke weight, rendered in #FFFFFF on #1B1E23 panels, no fills, no gradients, no drop shadows
style.lightingSystem: single hard directional key with strong raking side light to read shell curvature, shield edge and liner weave; crisp specular rim on shell edges and parting lines; deep falloff on low-key screens, soft bounce on pale screens; visible grounding contact shadow on every screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium dark-tech helmet ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of low-key field #14161C, slate panel #1B1E23, marble neutral band #F2F0ED, hairline grid paper #F7F7F5, matte neutral plate #EDEDEB, ink text #2D2D2D and one accent #C9A063; cool tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family with bold Chinese headline in 「」 and a small English kicker; alternating low-key studio cyclorama and pale technical grid background system; single hard directional key with raking side light, crisp specular rim on shell edges and deep falloff, always a visible grounding contact shadow; thin-line single-weight icon system; the product is presented as one complete shell with shield, inner visor, liner and vents intact at stable scale and baseline; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no invented certification marks, safety-standard badges or test seals
no numeric size, weight, rating or wind-resistance values baked into the image
no visible face, brand mark, watermark or QR code
style.presentationRules: the helmet is always one complete object with shell, outer shield, inner tinted visor, liner and vents intact; the same silhouette scale and baseline placement are held between screens; hero stays a front 3/4 reading angle so every later angle reads as the same object; part names stay generic to the category
style.surfaceSystem: glossy dark horizon plate #14161C for opening and closing screens, matte neutral plate #EDEDEB for hardware insets, hairline graph paper #F7F7F5 for structure screens, marble band #F2F0ED for the feature matrix header
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; bold Chinese headline in 「」 at 30-40pt, small English kicker at 12-16pt, body labels 13-16pt, hairline rules and small square tick markers only; text is injected as placeholders and composited in post
